interpretation.comparison: OrthoFinder3.1.5 full and other context tools retain original output semantics/provenance limits. No cross-endpoint mean, universal ranking or timing leaderboard.
interpretation.failures: Both original failed execution panels remain all-NA history rows, not biological negatives or inactivity.
interpretation.projection_repair: Original full-vector screen passes, with small OrthoBench/SwissTrees/TreeFam F1 gains, VGNC/Three Kingdoms F1 declines and mixed conditional functional means. OrthoBench paired intervals span zero. No all-metric or generalizable superiority.
interpretation.stopped: Species-balanced weighting, strict alignment guard, neutral local rescue and the two fixed reselection policies remain stopped at their original gates. Measurement mode is not an accuracy candidate.
interpretation.weighting: Both originally advancing Henikoff configurations retain complete passing development screens with mixed primary effects and uncertainty spanning zero.
